Q1: Newton (N). 1 mark for Newton. Accept N, newtons.
Q2: Gravity / gravitational force. 1 mark. Accept gravitation.
Q3: 15 m/s. 1 mark for 15 with correct unit. Accept 15 metres per second.
Q4: Any contact force e.g. friction, air resistance, tension, normal contact force, push, pull. 1 mark.
Q5: Velocity stays the same magnitude and direction / speed constant in a straight line. 1 mark.
Q6: 4 m/s². 1 mark for 4 with correct unit. From a = F/m = 20/5.
Q7: Energy cannot be created or destroyed, only transferred / transformed. Total energy stays constant. 1 mark.
Q8: Any renewable e.g. solar, wind, hydroelectric, tidal, wave, geothermal, biomass. 1 mark.
Q9: Volt (V). 1 mark. Accept volts, V.
Q10: The current is the same everywhere in a series circuit. 1 mark.
Q11: A magnet attracts magnetic materials / iron, steel, nickel, cobalt and repels/attracts other magnets. 1 mark.
Q12: e.g. increase number of coils / increase current in electromagnet, add more turns, use soft iron core. 1 mark. For permanent magnet: stroke method, stronger magnet.
Q13: Radiation. 1 mark.
Q14: Thermal expansion / expansion. 1 mark.
Q15: Angle of incidence = angle of reflection. 1 mark. Accept i = r, both measured to normal.
Q16: Longitudinal wave. 1 mark.
Q17: 20 Hz to 20,000 Hz. 1 mark. Accept 20 Hz - 20 kHz.
Q18: e.g. requires a medium / cannot travel in vacuum, longitudinal, reflects, refracts, diffracts, causes vibrations. 1 mark.
Q19: 4 g/cm³. 1 mark for 4 with correct unit. From density = mass/volume = 200/50.
Q20: Pressure = force / area (P = F/A). 1 mark.
Q21: 200 Pa. 1 mark for 200 with correct unit. From P = F/A = 100/0.5.
Q22: Pascal (Pa) / N/m². 1 mark. Accept Pa, pascals, newtons per square metre.
Q23: Air gets less dense / less air above / weight of air above decreases with height. 1 mark.
Q24: Ship has low average density due to large volume of air / displaces large weight of water so upthrust balances weight; nail is dense / average density > water so weight > upthrust. 1 mark.
Q25: N/kg. 1 mark. Accept newtons per kilogram.
Q26: 100 N. 1 mark for 100 with correct unit. From W = m x g = 10 x 10.
Q27: Constant maximum velocity when weight equals drag / resultant force zero. 1 mark.
Q28: Any valid use e.g. communication, cooking, medical imaging, heating, seeing. 1 mark. Accept radio, microwaves for cooking/communication, X-rays for imaging etc.
Q29: 3.0 x 10^8 m/s (300,000,000 m/s). 1 mark. Accept 3x10^8 m/s.
Q30: Any device e.g. telescope, microscope, camera, magnifying glass, glasses, projector. 1 mark.
